blender: make_light unified to params size/distance × scenePxScale (v5) — no hardcoded 4.5 / *0.004
method: Ground-plane predictions from params.light; Mac v4 ground unprojection for offset

light.note: Generator must keep size/dist == 420/900. Prior bug: dist=4.5 size=1.68 → 0.373

predictions.notePenumbra: Analytic h*size/distance for infinitesimal source. Finite disk softens differently; measured blur ≠ forced equality.

measuredGroundV4.penumbra_note: Sampling Δy=2.5mm coarse; finite-area soft shadow ≠ analytic penumbra width. Accept measured relation with documented difference — do not fake a coefficient to force equality.

blurThresholdDefinition.metric: 2×(y50−y10) of near-side alpha profile on ground after homography
blurThresholdDefinition.uncertainty: quantization 0.0025 m; RMSE reported per fit; prefer ≥3 lift samples
blurThresholdDefinition.do_not: Rescale measured blur by ad-hoc factor to match 0.4667

evidenceClass: [PROVISIONAL] analytical + measured offset PASS; penumbra documented difference [USER-HW]
